# Phobos Shipbreaker: equipment and item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-item-reference.ps1. Edit config/item-reference.json, not this file. -->

Current source candidate: **0.23.0**. Game target: **1.0.1.5**. Values below come from offline definitions; they do not establish installation, gameplay validation or a live merchant quote.

Rivetline machinery recovers material and casts rough industrial products. Asterel C1 provides optional central controls. Obtain loose equipment, place it through the indicated native INSTALL tab, supply electricity where required, and keep service approaches accessible. Local panels remain usable without C1. Receiving, processing and hot-furnace controls are separate permissions. Pending-equipment reloads include a bounded room-grid mitigation; see [evidence and limits](shipbreaker-room-load-mitigation.md). It cannot recover atmosphere already lost before saving. Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and native economic factors](solar-system-economy.md).

**Reading prices:** credits per complete object at the stated condition, before shop margins, market effects, negotiation and extra wear. Pristine retail can cost more. Mass is the empty/dry definition or fresh commodity template; saved contents and variable recovery packets can weigh differently. Dismantle value is the sum of all listed outputs at base value, excluding labour and tools.

**Repair and Restore:** Repair fixes a damaged form and retains the actual consumed service materials as spent parts. Restore reduces wear on functional equipment in place; it does not grant pristine status. Empty cargo and follow the machine’s local maintenance guards first. Work speed depends on crew, tools and current condition.

**Finding stock:** the generated percentages are defaults per eligible native stock/loot roll, not per ship or guaranteed shop availability. Offers are additive, may be independent, and require normal restocking. Merchant offers request the listed finite lot when successful; separate world-loot branches retain their own listed quantities. Configuration, capacity and native generation rules still apply; loading an existing save does not refill its inventories.

## D4 Dismantling Fixture

Processes already-detached ordinary wall panels into metal and a retained residue packet.

**Use:** Install on cabin flooring, supply power, put supported detached panels in its Wall-panel Feed or use the G4/H4 intake, then enable processing in its local panel. Products appear in the normal machine inventory.

**Where it appears:** Buy loose or damaged equipment, or build two D4-S sections and assemble the fixture.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

It does not cut attached hull walls. Fresh jobs make identified R2 feed; older bound jobs retain their original mixed-residue output. Processing pauses on reload.

Full operating instructions: [D4 Dismantling Fixture guide](shipbreaker-first-build.md).

## G4 Exterior Grabber

Collects detached wall panels for a connected D4.

**Use:** Position outside the hull aligned with the H4 chute and D4 as shown in the intake guide. Put eligible panels in the grabber Inventory and explicitly enable intake.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Not a mining head or an external hull cutter. Shipbreaker 0.22.0 adds exact-G4 native capture/release with mandatory Auto Nav 0.16.0+ and existing N1/N2 hardware. Owned, unoccupied targets only; no automatic cutting or repositioning. See [capture controls and limits](shipbreaker-capture.md).

Full operating instructions: [G4 Exterior Grabber guide](shipbreaker-hull-intake.md).

## H4 Sealed Hull Chute

Connects the exterior grabber and interior processor across intact structural flooring.

**Use:** Install in the documented G4 → H4 → D4 arrangement; align and power the associated equipment.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Backing walls remain the pressure barrier. The chute is not an open portal, pressure-cycling airlock or arbitrary conveyor network.

Full operating instructions: [H4 Sealed Hull Chute guide](shipbreaker-hull-intake.md).

## C2 Residue Collector

A finite physical cargo receiver for explicitly paired industrial outputs.

**Use:** Install at the hull, link the required machine/output port, select an exact filter and enable receiving. Empty its Inventory when full.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Full collectors block transfer; cargo stays at the sender. It does not jettison material or reduce ship mass. Furnace products need their explicit filter.

Full operating instructions: [C2 Residue Collector guide](residue-collector.md).

## R4 Scrap Reclaimer

Reclaims identified R2 panel residue into steel, aluminium and terminal rejects.

**Use:** Supply power and adequate cabin atmosphere, load exact R2 feed locally or enable a paired intake, then start processing. Set residue and metals output links independently.

**Where it appears:** Buy machinery or assemble two R4-S sections.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Legacy mixed residue and terminal rejects are not valid feed. The machine puts heat into cabin gas; vacuum is not free cooling. Receiving and processing pause on reload.

Full operating instructions: [R4 Scrap Reclaimer guide](scrap-reclaimer.md).

<a id="f6"></a>

## F6 Electric Furnace

Electrically heats an exact aluminium charge to cast a rough machinery housing.

**Use:** Build or buy the furnace, install it with a compatible cooling endpoint and power. Use the local panel to load, seal, heat and cast, then cool, equalize and release products. Follow the complete cycle guide.

**Where it appears:** Buy machinery or assemble three F6-S sections.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Requires finite cooling and a valid gas receiver. Direct coupling can transfer heat without power; piped circulation requires pump electricity. Automatic material receipt never authorizes Seal, Start or Release. Hot machinery retains heat across saves.

Full operating instructions: [F6 Electric Furnace guide](furnace-player-guide.md).

<a id="f6r"></a>

## F6-R Exterior Radiator

Rejects furnace heat through a finite exterior cooling assembly.

**Use:** Install in the documented exterior location and pair with the F6. Direct coupling or the optional dedicated coolant route is supported.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

One cooling endpoint per furnace. Direct coupling is passive; a remote piped installation needs powered circulation. A disconnected exposed radiator still rejects heat already in its own store. It is not an unlimited heat sink; do not switch pairs or modes while hot.

Full operating instructions: [F6-R Exterior Radiator guide](furnace-player-guide.md).

## F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port

A sealed deck fitting representing the alternative underside radiator assembly.

**Use:** Install at the documented furnace-side cooling attachment, rotated with the F6, and select its cooling pairing.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

The small head represents a complete finite assembly. It keeps the native floor sealed and does not vent cabin air or create a lower deck.

Full operating instructions: [F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port guide](furnace-connections-and-instruments.md).

<a id="f6c"></a>

## F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit

Provides the separate coolant route between the F6 and a remote F6-R.

**Use:** Place contiguous segments through HVAC, connect the correct cooling endpoints and select piped mode while cool and empty. Use the furnace’s checked routing controls.

**Where it appears:** Buy ordinary supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → HVAC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

This is not electrical cable or irrigation pipe. Legacy sealed operation and optional finite coolant servicing have different requirements. Damaged forms retain separate identities even when the display name lacks a damage suffix.

Full operating instructions: [F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit guide](furnace-coolant-conduits.md).

<a id="c1"></a>

## C1 Industrial Control Console

Provides central status and checked commands for installed industrial equipment on its own ship, with optional Agriculture integration.

**Use:** Install, power and use the seated console. Select a machine; filter by name, type or attention state and issue the available service commands.

**Where it appears:** Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → CTRL. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Physical cargo access and maintenance remain local. Docked, moored and towed ships are separate scopes; C1 is not required for autonomous processing.

<a id="compartments"></a>

## Built-in feed compartments

Named child inventories built into D4, R4 and F6. They are not separate products.

**Use:** Open the corresponding machine Inventory and put only its accepted wall panels, R2 residue or aluminium charge in the indicated compartment.

**Where it appears:** Shown as feed/chamber inventory within their owning machine.

**Placement:** Built into its parent machine; not separately installable.

No purchase, INSTALL, repair, Restore or standalone salvage contract. Empty-machine checks include these compartments.

Full operating instructions: [Built-in feed compartments guide](industrial-console-player-guide.md).

Included compartments: Phobos' Rivetline D4 Wall-panel Feed (4 panels / 96 kg); Phobos' Rivetline R4 Reclaimer Feed; Phobos' Rivetline F6 Aluminium charge chamber.

## Evidence and upkeep

Item names, dry/template masses, prices, service bills, salvage outputs, placement tabs, stock probabilities and table recipes are generated from current Phobos definitions. **Blue Bottle Games’ Ostranauts** native `DataCO.GetBasePrice` supplies the offline valuation used here ([developer’s game page](https://bluebottlegames.com/games/ostranauts)). That page identifies the game; the actual numeric evidence is the locally inspected assembly, whose hash is retained in the generated data snapshot. No proprietary source or game assembly is distributed.

Function/use explanations are maintained in the reviewed catalogue. All fictional prices, yields and simplified processing are Phobos gameplay choices. Research attribution remains beside the relevant claims in the linked operating/research guides. See [reference maintenance](item-reference-maintenance.md) for the one-click updater and coverage checks.
